task: BioMechania mech naming slate: MDickie-style proprietary-twist names inspired by Evangelion/Gundam/Zoids/Transformers/Bionicle/Kamen Rider/Power Rangers — candidates for owner picks, IP-collision checked
resume_brief: Produce a mech naming slate for BioMechania. Owner's formula (2026-10-09, binding): names like MDickie games do it — based on the mech each design is inspired by, with a slight change to make it proprietary, living in the BioMechania universe. Requirements per candidate: (1) evokes its inspiration source, (2) clearly original/proprietary — verify via web search that it doesn't collide with real franchise names/trademarks (no Gundam/Transformer/EVA/Zoid/Bionicle/Rider/Ranger names or near-identical), (3) fits BioMechania's biomech-derby tone, (4) MDickie-style: playful, readable, slightly off-kilter. Cover: a light recon mech line (replaces 'Scout'), a heavy combat mech line (replaces 'Bruiser'), plus 3-5 name candidates for each inspiration source (Evangelion, Gundam, Zoids, Transformers, Bionicle, Kamen Rider, Power Rangers) for future mech lines. Deliverable: docs/MECH_NAMING_SLATE.md on branch research/mech-naming-slate (pushed, not merged) with candidates grouped by inspiration, collision-check notes, and your top pick per slot marked. Report back the shortlist for the owner to choose from. Standing rules: heartbeat this checkpoint, branch->PR, disk <=75%.
notes: Slate delivered: docs/MECH_NAMING_SLATE.md on branch research/mech-naming-slate (439f08a), pushed to origin, NOT merged. 35 candidates across 9 slots, 11 dropped on IP collision. Owner shortlist: SKITTER, POUNDCAKE, VANGEL, VERNIER, ZOYD, FORMCHAIN, MASKJACK, HENSHIN, RANGERDANGER.
